PAUSED

World auto-saves edits to this browser.

HOW TO PLAY
  • Move with WASD, jump with Space. Hold Shift to sprint.
  • Mine with left click, place with right click.
  • Press F to fly (Space up / Shift down), 1–9 or mouse wheel to change block.
  • Press H anytime for this panel. Esc releases the mouse.
